property_summary: Invariant: calling burn(uint256) by the contract owner never changes the owner storage; the mutant that sets owner = tx.origin inside owned() can cause owner to differ after burn when owner was set via a call that makes msg.sender != tx.origin (i.e. when an intermediate contract calls owned()).

Rule: calling burn(uint256) from an EOA never changes c.owner(); the mutant that assigns owner = tx.origin inside owned() can make owner differ when owner was previously set via a contract call (so after burn invoked by a contract-owned flow owner differs).
